title: Technical Leader – React Native
jobDescription:
Experience: 8 to 11 years Work Mode: Hybrid Role Overview: We are looking for a skilled React Native Lead with 8+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and delivering high-performance cross-platform mobile applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React Native, proven leadership capabilities, and a solid understanding of mobile application architecture, API integration, and industry best practices. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Type Script. Lead the end-to-end mobile application development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and production support. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and backend developers, to deliver scalable and user-friendly mobile solutions. Develop and integrate RESTful Web Services to ensure seamless communication between mobile applications and backend systems. Implement and maintain integrations with Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), Mo Engage, and payment gateways. Build, test, debug, and deploy applications using React Native CLI, Microsoft Visual Studio, Xcode, and Android Studio. Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and stability across both Android and i OS platforms. Conduct code reviews, mentor developers, and promote coding standards and best practices within the team. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues while ensuring high code quality and application reliability. Stay up to date with emerging mobile technologies, React Native advancements, and industry best practices to drive continuous improvement. title: US IT Recruiter
jobDescription:
Work Mode: Hybrid Employment Type: Contractor / Full-time Role Overview: We are looking for a results-driven US IT Recruiter with strong sourcing expertise and a solid grasp of the US staffing landscape. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Excellent communication skills with complete understanding of the US Staffing process. Excellent sourcing, screening and negotiation skills. Proficient with job boards, postings, sourcing, searching skills via Linked In Dice, Monster, Career Builder, etc. Evaluate candidate’s strengths compared with client's requirements by screening and interviewing the candidate. Negotiate wage rates and other terms and conditions of employment with candidates and gain commitment from candidates for current and future job requirements. Ensure meeting daily/monthly target of submitting quality candidates for open job requirements released by clients. Arranging interviews for shortlisted candidates and following up on real-time basis till feedback is received from client. Exposure towards working in ATS and should capture all the activity in it. Sending daily activity reports of submitting and interview updates to the leads. Clear understanding of US benefits, compensation, employment types and terms and conditions. Requirements: 3 to 5 years of solid sourcing experience in IT domain, preferably from a consulting background. The candidate must be willing to work in the night shift. Familiar with MS Word, MS Excel, MS Powerpoint, and MS Outlook (or similar email application) and use of search string to find the right candidate in a short span of time. Have a desire to learn and advance in a fast-paced environment and be capable of regularly using good judgment and discretion to accomplish goals and work requirements. Familiar with US work visas, US tax terms, different work status and Time Zone. Candidates with Hands-on experience with end-to-end IT Recruiting will be given preference. The candidate must possess excellent connect with vendors. The candidates to have minimum understanding on contract agreements. Fluent communication skills: This role requires daily coordination (Call &email) with Candidates, Vendors, team leads and account managers therefore, fluency in English is mandatory. Thorough understanding of IT domain- Skills, Market trends. A positive attitude and a willingness to learn Job description. Excellent communication skills with complete understanding of the US Staffing process.
